$comment: Structured-output schema for one triage result (output_config.format, type json_schema). Every key required, no nullable types, additionalProperties false, enum comparison case-insensitive (structured-outputs docs: enum casing is not guaranteed). Confidence is an integer in basis points 0..10000; numeric bounds are not supported by the API's schema subset, so the pipeline rejects out-of-range values after parsing. The model is not asked for route: route is derived from category and priority by routing/policy.v1.json (D-13).

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the ticket body, lowercase

reason.description: one sentence, quoting the words in the ticket that decided the category
